about.title: One connected rental journey.
about.text: Discover verified listings, apply, schedule viewings, agree on terms and complete a rental agreement without scattering important details across chats and paper records.

overview.textOwner: See what needs your attention now, then move each rental from application to a completed agreement.
overview.textRenter: See your applications and next actions without digging through extra management tools.

apps.title: Rental applications
apps.textOwner: Review renter requests and follow accepted applications through final terms and a completed agreement.
apps.textRenter: Track each application from the owner decision through final terms and a completed agreement.
apps.acceptedOwnerNoTerms: This renter has been selected. Confirm the final rent, deposit, move-in date and duration before an agreement is created.
apps.acceptedRenterNoTerms: Your application was accepted. The owner is preparing the final rental terms for you to review.
apps.waitingRenter: Waiting for the renter to accept these terms or request a change.
apps.changeRequestedOwner: The renter requested changes. Discuss them in messages, then revise and resend the terms.
apps.emptyOwner: Applications for your published properties will appear here.
apps.emptyRenter: Browse rentals and apply when you find the right home.
apps.confirmAccept:
Accept {{applicant}} for {{property}}?

Every other pending application for this property will be rejected automatically, and this cannot be undone.
apps.defaultRejectReason: Application was not selected at this time.
apps.agreementNoneOwner: Terms accepted by the renter. Create the rental agreement when you are ready.
apps.agreementNoneRenter: Terms accepted. The owner is preparing the rental agreement.
apps.agreementExecuted: Agreement complete. Both parties have accepted the rental agreement.
apps.agreementWaitingMe: The rental agreement is ready and waiting for your acceptance.
apps.agreementWaitingOther: You accepted the agreement. Waiting for the {{party}} to accept it.
apps.modalIntroTitle: Send the final proposal to the renter
apps.modalIntroText: These values should reflect what you and the renter discussed. Sending them does not start a tenancy or charge either person.
apps.depositPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the listed deposit
apps.reservedNote: The property remains reserved while both sides finalize the deal.
apps.changeIntroTitle: Tell the owner what you would like to change
apps.changeIntroText: Ask about the move-in date, deposit, rent, duration or occupants, then continue the discussion in Messages.
apps.changePlaceholder: Example: Could we reduce the security deposit?
apps.confirmAcceptHostel:
Accept {{applicant}} for a {{count}} seater room at {{property}}?

Their places come off your free count. Other students' applications stay open.

msg.title: Messages
msg.text: Property-linked conversations keep every discussion attached to the correct rental journey.
msg.noConversationsText: Open a property and message its owner to start one.
msg.noMessagesText: Send the first message in this rental conversation.

agr.title: Agreements
agr.textOwner: Turn accepted rental terms into a clear agreement, then wait for both sides to accept it before the rental begins.
agr.textRenter: Review the agreement created from the rental terms you already accepted, then explicitly confirm it using your legal name.
agr.ownerNote: These terms were accepted by the renter. Create the agreement from these exact values; neither side needs to re-enter the deal.
agr.renterNote: The owner has not created the rental agreement yet. Your accepted terms remain reserved and unchanged.
agr.executedNote: Both sides accepted the agreement. Your rental agreement is complete.
agr.otherAccepted: The other party has already accepted. Your acceptance will finalize the agreement.
agr.emptyText: An agreement appears after final rental terms have been accepted.
agr.modalIntroText: This records your explicit electronic acceptance. It is not a cryptographic digital signature. Once both parties accept, the rental agreement is complete.
agr.legalNameHint: Enter the name you are using to accept this rental agreement.

rev.title: Reviews

rev.chooseRentalFirst: Choose the rental you're reviewing first.

prof.title: Your profile
prof.text: Keep your contact details current while your email, role and verification status stay protected.
prof.editText: You can change your display name and contact number. Changing your phone number clears its verification status until it is verified again.
prof.protectedNote: Email, role and account verification details are protected. Use Edit profile to update your name or phone number.

rep.title: Your reports
rep.text: Report a property or user for review by platform administrators.

own.title: Your properties
own.text: Create, edit, upload images and submit listings for admin publication.
own.emptyText: Create your first property after owner verification is approved.
own.lockedNote: A renter has been accepted for this listing, so it is locked. It cannot be edited or deleted while the rental is in progress.
own.retiredTypeNote: "Private room" and "Shared room" are no longer offered, so this listing is hidden from search. Edit it, choose the type that fits best and submit it for review again.
own.seatsInvalid: Free places must be whole numbers from 0 to 1000.

ver.title: Owner verification
ver.text: Identity verification is required before listing a property. Documents are private and reviewed by administrators.
ver.cnicHint: Use only the last 4 digits of the CNIC.
ver.verifiedNote: You can now create and submit property listings.
ver.waitingNote: Your documents are waiting for an administrator decision.
ver.mustBeImage: {{label}} must be a JPG or PNG image.
ver.tooLarge: {{label}} is {{size}}. Please choose an image smaller than 1 MB.
ver.rejectedNote: An administrator closed this request without allowing a resubmission. Use the reason above, and contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

admin.trustText: Review owners, listings and safety reports from one protected workspace.
admin.signedInAs: Signed in as {{name}}. Review the queues that require a human decision.
admin.overviewError: Unable to load the admin overview
admin.overviewErrorText: The moderation queues are still protected. Retry the dashboard request to refresh their current counts.
admin.explicitText: Owner identity, property publication and safety reports remain separate review queues so each decision has a clear purpose, controlled access and audit trail.
admin.reportsText: Review user-submitted reports and record the moderation outcome.

adm.queueText: Open a submission to inspect its complete listing, images, amenities and owner details before deciding.
adm.submittedOn: Submitted {{date}}. Confirm the listing is coherent and suitable for publication.
adm.rejectPlaceholder: Explain what must be changed before resubmission
adm.verificationQueueText: Review private identity submissions before a user can publish rental properties.
adm.privateDocumentsText: These files are fetched only through the protected administrator endpoint and are not public URLs.
adm.verificationRejectPlaceholder: Explain why the identity submission cannot be approved
adm.allowResubmit: Allow the user to resubmit clearer documents

media.title: Photos & cover image
media.text: Upload, reorder, choose the cover and remove images before submitting a listing for review.
media.createFirstText: Media management becomes available after a draft listing exists.
media.drop: Drop one JPG or PNG property photo here
media.dropHint: One image at a time · maximum 1 MB per image · up to 10 images per property
media.emptyText: Upload at least three images and choose exactly one cover before submitting for review.
media.chooseSmaller: Choose one JPG or PNG image smaller than 1 MB.

ed.text: Complete one clear section at a time. Required fields are labelled, optional details can be skipped, and your listing stays a draft until you submit it for admin review.
ed.lockedStep: Save the draft before opening this step

step.locationText: The area, then the exact spot on the map.
step.reviewText: Check the listing before sending it to the admin review queue.
step.roomsText: Room types, nightly prices and check-in times
step.typeText: What are you listing? This decides the questions that follow.
step.aboutText: A title, a description and the details renters ask about first.
step.utilitiesText: Heating, power, water and road access. Skip anything you're not sure about.
step.priceText: Monthly rent, advance, minimum stay and move-in date.
step.photosText: At least three clear photos, one of them the cover.

notice.pricing: Amounts are in Pakistani rupees. The advance can be zero; "negotiable" just tells renters you're open to discussing the rent.
notice.location: Type the area and city, then drop a pin on the map exactly where the property is. The map opens on your current location — search a place or tap anywhere to move the pin.
notice.living: Renters filter by these facts. Skip anything you're not sure about — "not said" is better than a guess.
notice.images: Upload at least three clear JPG or PNG photos. Upload one image at a time and keep every image smaller than 1 MB. The first uploaded image becomes the initial cover automatically.
notice.rooms: Add each kind of room you offer. Guests book a room type for their dates, and the number of rooms you enter is what stops double bookings.
notice.hostelPrices: Add each room size you offer. Choose whether prices are per person or for the whole room, and how many places are free. Accepting a student takes their places automatically; add them back when someone leaves.

field.title: Property title
field.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the condition, surroundings, nearby places and the kind of renter this property suits.
field.rentHint: Amount charged each month, for example 45000.
field.depositHint: Refundable amount paid before moving in. Enter 0 if none.
field.availableFromHint: The earliest date a renter can move in.
field.areaHint: Example: Jutial, Danyore, Konodas or another local area.
field.streetHint: Street, road or block information if available.
field.cityHint: Defaults to Gilgit but can be changed if the property is elsewhere in the supported area.
field.landmarkHint: A well-known nearby place that helps renters recognize the location.
field.waterHint: Rate the normal reliability of running water at the property.
field.roadHint: Rate how easily renters can normally reach the property by road.
field.shopAreaHint: Shopkeepers compare shops mainly by floor area.
field.titleTip: Say what it is and where. 5–120 characters.
field.sizeHint: Covered area or plot size, as you usually say it.
field.tenantTypesHint: Pick none to rent to anyone.
field.separateMetersHint: So the tenant pays only their own bills.
field.winterAccessHint: Can a car reach it after snow?
field.gateClosesAtHint: Leave empty if there is no gate time.

ed.nextPhotos: Next: save the draft and add photos
ed.nextPhotosText: Photos can only be added to a saved listing. The next button saves the draft and takes you straight to the Photos step.
ed.saveFirstText: Finish the first five steps and save the draft before adding photos.
ed.dragPhoto: Drag one photo here or click to choose a file
ed.dragPhotoHint: JPG or PNG · one image at a time · 1 MB maximum per image · 10 images per property
ed.readyDetails: Type, location, details and price are complete
ed.readyNote: When everything is ready, return to Your Properties and click "Submit for review". The property remains a private draft until then.
